card.name: The word unless introducing an exception
card.fires_on: The word "unless" (and sometimes the "the" right after it or after "whenever") that begins an exception clause after an instruction to avoid or not do something in a drug label.

modes.label: Unless after avoid-use
modes.description: "unless" follows a warning to avoid a product in a patient group, before a condition like essential diagnostic information.
modes.example: Avoid use of EOVIST in these patients<< unless>> the diagnostic information is essential and not available

modes.label: Unless after do-not instructions
modes.description: "unless" follows a handling or testing instruction, before a condition that must be met.
modes.example: Do not administer<< unless>> solution is clear and seal is intact.

modes.label: The after condition word
modes.description: "the" follows "whenever" or "unless" and opens the condition clause.
modes.example: prior to administration, whenever<< the>> solution and container permit.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label states the one condition under which a restriction can be set aside.
